Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
A few make-sure questions for the above Patricia-deck:

1. Must Patricia Giovanni fulfill the requirements of the retainer she
attempts to employ? I.e. can she get Charnas for me?
2. If she can employ charnas, does she still get to put him on another
vampire?
3. Situation: Vamp A has Charnas and Society of Leopold and one blood. Whicj
effect takes place first: Charnas, when untapping or Leopold, during untap.
I.e can A first burn one blood for Leopold, then take one damage from
charnas and thus avoiding to burn? More complicated: A has Vampiric Disease
and Leopold and no blood plus hunting ground. Can he/she first fail to burn
blood for disease, then gain one blood from hunting ground and then burn
that blood for Leopold?
4. When recruiting Charnas via sup. Compel the Spirit, do I still have to
put him on the acting vampire? And do I have to be a tremere?

Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
One more:
If Patricia can employ Charnas, is that action then still a (D) action???

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henke wrote:
>
> A few make-sure questions for the above Patricia-deck:
>
> 1. Must Patricia Giovanni fulfill the requirements of the retainer she
> attempts to employ? I.e. can she get Charnas for me?

Yes. I.e. Not unless she's a Tremere.

> 2. If she can employ charnas, does she still get to put him on another
> vampire?

Yes, by card text on Charnas.
This is a (D) action if the target minion is controlled by another
Methuselah [6.2.2.1]

> 3. Situation: Vamp A has Charnas and Society of Leopold and one blood. Whicj
> effect takes place first: Charnas, when untapping or Leopold, during untap.

Charnas. Untapping is the first thing that happens in the untap phase. [4]

> I.e can A first burn one blood for Leopold, then take one damage from
> charnas and thus avoiding to burn? More complicated: A has Vampiric Disease

No.

> and Leopold and no blood plus hunting ground. Can he/she first fail to burn
> blood for disease, then gain one blood from hunting ground and then burn
> that blood for Leopold?

Yes.

> 4. When recruiting Charnas via sup. Compel the Spirit, do I still have to
> put him on the acting vampire? And do I have to be a tremere?

Yes (card text), since Compel is not an "employ" action. No.
